content: Golden-dataset regression testing: golden set is a versioned collection of (input, context, judgment criteria) triples used as baseline; even temperature=0 does not guarantee byte-identical output across infra/model-version changes; exact-match assertions are the wrong tool — use semantic similarity (cosine/BERTScore) or LLM-as-judge with documented thresholds, and rerun the full golden set on every model/prompt/retriever/tool change.
